mechanism_claims.claim_text: P-α-02-B has direct membrane-disruption evidence in E. coli ATCC 25922 and membrane-damage morphology evidence in S. aureus and E. coli.

method_locators: xml:sec=19:Outer and inner membrane permeabilization assays

mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact fluorescence/image intensities were not digitized from figure panels; mechanism conclusion is qualitative direct membrane-disruption support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AAMD simulations support a stronger membrane disturbance model for P-α-02-B than sC184b, but this is computational support rather than direct cellular mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote AAMD alone to direct mechanism; it is model support for membrane interaction.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: P-α-02-B shows phenotype-level bactericidal, anti-biofilm, and levofloxacin partial-synergy evidence, supporting antimicrobial effect but not a separate molecular target claim.

locator: xml:sec=33:Synergistic Effects of P-α-02-B with Conventional Antibiotics

mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic synergy and biofilm effects are not normalized as a direct intracellular target.
